items.office: Chief Justice, Maine Supreme Judicial Court
items.t: Pledged to "uphold the rule of law" and deliver "fair and impartial justice."
items.q: “I pledge to the people of Maine that I will serve them honorably and faithfully, that I will uphold the rule of law, and that I will work every day to deliver fair and impartial justice.” Since February 2020, Justice Stanfill has served on the Maine Superior Court presiding over Androscoggin, Oxford and Franklin Counties, a position to which Governor Mills nominated her.

record.t: Served on the Maine Superior Court from February 2020 before her nomination as chief justice.
record.q: “I pledge to the people of Maine that I will serve them honorably and faithfully, that I will uphold the rule of law, and that I will work every day to deliver fair and impartial justice.” Since February 2020, Justice Stanfill has served on the Maine Superior Court presiding over Androscoggin, Oxford and Franklin Counties, a position to which Governor Mills nominated her.

record.office: Chief Justice, Maine Supreme Judicial Court
record.t: Is the second woman nominated and confirmed as chief justice of the Maine Supreme Judicial Court.
record.q: Chief Justice Stanfill is the second woman to be nominated and confirmed as Chief Justice, following the Honorable Leigh Ingalls Saufley, who resigned in April 2020 to accept a position as Dean of the University of Maine School of Law.

record.t: Was first nominated to the District Court by Gov. John Baldacci and renominated by Gov. Paul LePage.
record.q: Justice Stanfill was first nominated to the District Court by Governor John Baldacci and renominated by Governor Paul LePage.

record.t: Practiced law in Lewiston for 15 years and directed the Cumberland Legal Aid Clinic before joining the bench.
record.q: Before joining the bench, Chief Justice Stanfill practiced law for 15 years in Lewiston and was a visiting professor at the University of Maine Law and Director of the Cumberland Legal Aid Clinic, where she taught trial practice and advanced trial advocacy.
